note: Toddler-friendly events near Sauvie Island, St. Johns, Portland, Vancouver and the coast, soonest first. Several holiday dates are reported by guides but not yet confirmed by organizers, so check before going.

events.title: Storytime at Washington County Libraries
events.detail: There's a storytime pretty much every day of the week at Washington County Libraries! These range from: Preschool Storytimes, Family Storytimes, Toddler Times, Book Babies, storytimes in various languages, and

events.title: Make Memories With Llamas, a Corn Maze and Pumpkins at Frog Pond Farm
events.where: Frog Pond Farm, 2995 SW Advance Rd, Wilsonville, OR, United States
events.detail: Llamas in the Pumpkin Patch? Only at Frog Pond Farm. Open daily starting September 18, Frog Pond Farm is a place where animals take center stage, memories are made, and

events.title: Corn Maze & Fall Fun at Bella Organic Farm
events.where: Bella Organic Farm, 16205 NW Gillihan Rd., Portland, OR, United States
events.detail: Get lost in their family-friendly corn maze, featuring a "Five Kind Acts" theme, open daily August 22-October 31! Starting September 26, enjoy extended fall hours with even more pumpkin patch

events.title: Lee Farms Fall Festival & Pumpkin Patch
events.detail: Corn maze, hayrides, and farm animals. 9:00 am - 6:00 pm.

events.title: Mike Bennett Spooktacular Scavenger Hunt at Bridgeport Village
events.detail: Search for nine hidden Halloween ghosts on shop windows. Free.

events.title: Weaving Time: NUNO – Textiles of Tradition and Transformation at Portland Japanese Garden
events.detail: Experience an exhibition of Japanese textile design and installations. 10:00 am - 5:30 pm. Included with admission.

events.title: Hallo-Week at Vancouver Mall
events.detail: Family-friendly Halloween festivities including crafts and indoor trick-or-treating. 5:00 pm - 7:00 pm. Free.

events.title: Storytime at Washington County Libraries
events.detail: Various storytime sessions including Toddler Times are available. Free.

events.title: Sing, Sign & Play @ SWPMA PLAY!
events.detail: Playtime with singing and basic American Sign Language. 9:00 am - 9:50 am.

events.title: Seaside Halloween Happenin's
events.detail: Family festival with a kids' activity zone and downtown trick-or-treating, plus a giant pumpkin drop at 3 pm on Sunday, Nov 1.

events.title: Halloween weekend at Astoria KOA
events.detail: Pumpkin Patch Express train, pumpkin decorating, trick-or-treating and a costume parade on Saturday. Skip the evening Haunted Cove with a toddler.

events.title: Sauvie Island Pumpkin Patch and corn maze
events.detail: Pumpkins and an 8-acre corn maze, listed daily 10 to 6 through Oct 31 with prices starting at $12. Last season's FAQ said kids under 6 were free; confirm this year.

events.title: Bella Organic pumpkin patch
events.detail: Free hayrides out to a corn maze and pumpkin field. Go in daytime, since the maze is haunted on weekend evenings.

events.title: Curiosity Kids at OMSI
events.detail: Hands-on 9 to 10 am Saturday sessions for ages 3 to 5 with family, including same-day museum admission: Become a Nature Detective (Oct 31, Nov 21), Design and Discover (Nov 7, Nov 28) and Sasquatch Science Team (Nov 14). Up to 20 people per class.

events.title: Native Games and Storytelling
events.detail: Native American Heritage Month program with traditional games and stories from a community storyteller, 12 to 1:15. Free.

events.title: Black Family Storytime
events.detail: Sunday storytime from 3:30 to 4:15 in the large community room. Free.

events.title: OMSI $5 Day
events.detail: Museum admission is $5 per person, with planetarium and theater shows also $5. OMSI expects crowds and suggests buying tickets online ahead.

events.title: Sensory Sunday at Columbia River Maritime Museum
events.detail: Calm family morning from 9:30 to 11 with lowered sound, a quiet station and a craft, held the first Sunday of the month. The Nov 1 date follows that pattern but isn't confirmed; regular admission applies.

events.title: Fall Discount Days at the Oregon Zoo
events.detail: $13 admission from 9:30 to 3:30. The zoo's events calendar lists Nov 2 to 8, but the event page still shows last year's dates, so confirm before going.

events.title: Portland Holiday Market
events.detail: Big holiday craft, food and gift show, Fri and Sat 10 to 7 and Sun 10 to 6 (one page on the site says 5 on Sunday).

events.title: Christmas tree arrival at Pioneer Courthouse Square
events.detail: Free late-morning welcome for the Square's big tree, 11 to 12:30, with Santa and free hot chocolate.

events.title: Veterans Day
events.detail: The Oregon Zoo is proud to offer free admission on Veterans Day for military members, veterans and their families from 9:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.

events.title: ZooLights Sensory-Friendly
events.detail: Guests with different sensory processing needs and their families can enjoy the wonder of ZooLights from 4:30 to 8:30 p.m.

events.title: ZooLights
events.detail: Holiday lights nightly from 4:30, closed Nov 24 to 26 and Dec 25. Ticketed separately from daytime zoo admission; Any Night tickets can be bought ahead.

events.title: Pioneer Courthouse Square tree lighting
events.detail: Free sing-along with Santa lighting the tree, reported for 5:30 to 6:45. Another listing says Nov 29, so confirm before going.

events.title: Christmas Festival of Lights at The Grotto
events.detail: Walk-through holiday lights; The Grotto lists Nov 27 to Dec 30, 2026.

events.title: Winter Wonderland drive-through lights
events.detail: Drive-through light show, so a toddler can stay cozy in a car seat. A Portland travel guide reports the Nov 27 to Dec 31 dates as confirmed.

events.title: Vancouver Community Tree Lighting
events.detail: Free Rotary celebration where Santa arrives escorted by the Christmas Ships. The Christmas Ships calendar lists it for Nov 27, though the Rotary hasn't posted 2026 details yet.
